connector.name: Obsidian Sync MCP
connector.registryDescription: Give AI agents access to your Obsidian vault via local files or Self-hosted LiveSync.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package obsidian-sync-mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the es617 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: VAULT_PATH
env.description: Path to your Obsidian vault directory (filesystem mode)

env.name: COUCHDB_PASSPHRASE
env.description: LiveSync E2E encryption passphrase (must match plugin setting)

env.name: COUCHDB_OBFUSCATE_PROPERTIES
env.description: Set to 'true' if 'Obfuscate Properties' is enabled in LiveSync (obfuscates file paths, sizes, dates)

env.name: VAULT_NAME
env.description: Vault name for deep links and index storage

env.name: BASE_URL
env.description: Public URL for OAuth callbacks (required when using a tunnel)
